source: DECISIONS.md D75 (licence policy). Change this file only through a reviewed PR that also changes D75 or its licence exceptions register.

fonts_and_data.note: D75 allows these licences only for fonts (OFL) and for data and model weights (CC0, CC-BY, CDLA-Permissive-2.0), so they pass only for the packages listed under `packages` below.

not_packages.LOINC: Terminology data, allowed by name in D75. It isn't a package, so no lockfile carries it.

separate_programs.note: D75's scope: separate programs (here, container images we run but never link into our code) may use any OSI-approved licence. Only an image entry with "scope": "separate-program" may use these; a package never can.

npm:@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sa.register: DECISIONS.md D75: OFL for fonts (the design system's typeface)

npm:caniuse-lite.register: DECISIONS.md D75: CC-BY for data (browser-support tables; build tool, dev only)

npm:language-subtag-registry.register: DECISIONS.md D75: CC0 for data (IANA language subtags; dev only)

npm:mdn-data.register: DECISIONS.md D75: CC0 for data (CSS property data; dev only)

quay.io/openbao/openbao.use: Development and CI only: the OpenBao dev server with Transit for field encryption (core/crypto.py). Never the test server or production.

nginx.source: https://nginx.org/LICENSE (the image has no licence label)

chrislusf/seaweedfs.use: Development only: the file store with its S3 API, chunks encrypted (infra/compose/seaweedfs).

clamav/clamav.use: Development: clamd for the upload scan (the file service talks to it over TCP; nothing is linked).
clamav/clamav.source: https://github.com/Cisco-Talos/clamav (COPYING.txt, GPL-2.0; the image has no licence label); image built 2026-08-03. 1.5.4 (2026-10-26) is too new for the 7-day rule
